$extensions.source: Measured. .metadata and .secondary-action font-family on https://tome.app/.
Measured. h1 computed style on the 404 page.
Measured. .description computed style. letter-spacing was normal and is recorded as 0px.
Measured. .primary-action computed style. The control is in the DOM with hidden set, so it is not shown.
Measured. .metadata and .secondary-action computed style.
Measured. .primary-action border-radius, and the focus-visible radius on .secondary-action.
Measured. .metadata gap, and the .secondary-action::before inset.
Measured. .description margin-top. Also the narrow-layout .secondary-actions-with-logs gap, which was not shown.
Measured. .primary-action horizontal padding and .secondary-actions gap.
Measured. .metadata margin-top while .primary-action[hidden] is present.
Measured. .primary-action margin-top. Also main padding at max-width 500px, confirmed at 390px.
Measured. main padding at the 1169px and 1440px viewports.
Measured. .secondary-actions bottom at the 1169px viewport, before the safe-area inset.
Measured. .primary-action height. The control is hidden.
Measured. --content-width, and .secondary-actions width.
Measured. --content-max-width. The h1 box was 360px wide.
Measured. focus-visible outline width on .secondary-action.
Measured. focus-visible outline-offset on .secondary-action.
Measured. transition duration on .primary-action and .secondary-action.
Derived. The stylesheet says transition timing ease, which the browser computed as 0.15s with the ease keyword.

$extensions.note: Declared in the page stylesheet and confirmed in computed transition strings. Not probed with emulateMedia.
